MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Heat shrink tubing feels useful because it complements my wire connectors by insulating electrical repairs.",
    "Plastic bonder fits the practical repair needs suggested by my tape and vinyl cement purchases, particularly when a repair needs a rigid bond."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The nuts, washers and rivet inserts require specific matching dimensions and projects; my hose clamp purchases do not establish those needs.",
    "Caulk, O-ring lubricant and a feeler gauge address tasks I have not shown a need for, while the large thin-glue refill assumes more specialized adhesive use than my history supports.",
    "The examination gloves depend on fit and suitability for my repair materials, neither of which I can establish from the recommendation."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of repair supplies seem to have been treated as interest in almost any maintenance tool or hardware.",
    "A familiar brand or a shared use for fastening and bonding seems to have counted too heavily when the actual application, dimensions or quantity differ."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I care about whether an item completes a concrete repair task, such as insulating the connections made with my wire connectors.",
    "My purchases are spread over years, so they do not establish that every past project is still active or that I need bulk supplies now.",
    "Compatibility matters: thread size, material, fit and adhesive properties can determine whether a seemingly related item is useful at all."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but often assumed specific projects and supply needs that my history does not establish."
}
